review: 702.186b triage: the infinity ability of The Soul Stone is a triggered ability, which 702.186b-1 observes as a trigger record; added trigger to the rule record_kinds.

scenarios.title: A harnessed permanent has the ability that follows the infinity symbol

setup.notes: The Soul Stone is harnessed. Its infinity ability reads: at the beginning of your upkeep, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

decisions: The upkeep of A begins; the infinity ability of The Soul Stone triggers and A targets Grizzly Bears in A's graveyard.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves.

variants.label: harnessed
variants.expected: The triggered ability fires. Grizzly Bears moves from A's graveyard to the battlefield under A's control.

variants.label: not_harnessed
variants.delta: The Soul Stone is not harnessed.
variants.expected: The triggered ability does not fire. Grizzly Bears stays in A's graveyard.
